evidence: Source-level: frozen tests/test.sh (sha256 bd68259276ca4b034654efc8a1723a4e702ed62dbe590af6201565f43eabe5aa), tests/tools/score.py, restart_mcp.py, tests/Dockerfile and .dockerignore are byte-identical to the frozen template (diff empty). bash -n OK, LF only, shebang #!/bin/bash, no '^\s*exec\s' (only find -exec). Contract items checked against staged-task-contract.md: (1) write_zero_reward at test.sh:60 writes reward.txt 0.0 + full ZERO_REWARD_JSON (reward, five dims, gates_passed, floors_passed, weighted_score, graded, no_op) + ctrf, then 'trap cleanup EXIT' (:61) whose cleanup kills the app process group and calls ensure_reward. (2) Every early exit is 'exit 0' after the zero record: missing REWARDKIT_JUDGE/MODEL (:63-66), missing /app/server.js (:68-70), symlink outside /app/node_modules or resolving outside it (:72-83), liveness failure after 120x0.25s (:115-125), gates suite failure/timeout (:213-215), score.py exit 1 keeps detailed gate record with reward 0 (:218-221), other score.py failure rewrites plain zero (:221), scored suite failure (:224-226), final score.py failure -> write_zero_reward (:227). set -e aborts (e.g. cp failure, app_context substitution crash) still hit the EXIT trap, and reward.txt already exists. (3) Safe launch: /app copied aside, chown 65534, writability test picks /app or copy, setsid env -i with only PATH, NODE_PATH, HOME, PORT=3000, DB_PATH, setpriv --reuid/--regid 65534 --clear-groups (:90-111); pid recorded for process-group kill. (4) Liveness probe on 127.0.0.1:3000/api/health then / before any RewardKit call (:42-58, :115-125). (5) Restart helper generated by heredoc + sed, chmod 755, APP_RESTART_HELPER exported (:127-193); functional judge.toml:18 consumes "$APP_RESTART_HELPER". (6) {app_context} substituted from tests/app_context.md (present) (:195-201). (7) gates suite (timeout 1500) then score.py; (8) scored suite (timeout 11100) then score.py; stale $LOG_DIR/scored removed first (:212). score.py validates finite 0-1 dimensions, returns 0/1/2, exit 2 on any exception. Task fit: golden server.js -> src/index.js -> bootstrap.js listens on PORT (default 3000) on 0.0.0.0 and answers GET /api/health 200 before the SQLite worker starts; non-health requests await worker readiness, so liveness cannot race the judge into 503s on the golden; db.js honours DB_PATH and only mkdirs its dirname; instruction.md:15-17 and integration.md:5-23 state the entry, port, health path, DB_PATH, unprivileged different-cwd launch and symlink rule that test.sh relies on. Timeout nesting relevant to 'always scores': gates 2 batched x 600 = 1200 <= 1500; scored functional individual 15 x 600 + polish 900 + visual 900 = 10800 <= 11100 with --max-concurrent-agent 1; 1500 + 11100 + <=30 s liveness = 12630 < verifier 13200, so test.sh itself (not the outer harness SIGKILL) should end the run and the EXIT trap writes a reward. Counterexample attempts: (a) broken app answering only /api/health passes liveness but the gate judges, not test.sh, must exclude it (out of this row); a symlinked /app/server.js or a link escaping node_modules is refused with a zero reward. (b) Conforming alternative without /api/health still passes the probe via '/', and any HTTP error status counts as alive, so a correct but slow-to-500 app is not wrongly zeroed by test.sh; a conforming app that obeys the brief (fast DB-free health, writes only under /app or DB_PATH) launches under uid 65534. No conforming app found that test.sh would fail. Colderwater lessons bearing on this row: L11 judge infra crashes - a crashed/timeout gates or scored RewardKit run makes test.sh exit 0 with reward 0 (template behaviour, not editable here); L19 golden harness 'launches like test.sh' - the raw evidence via-solve.sh only mimics the chown, it does not run test.sh. Latent notes (template-controlled, not task defects): mkdir/chmod 700 of LOG_DIR (:10-11) run under set -e before the zero record and trap; if the harness LOG_DIR is unwritable no reward is written (P3, harness provides it). After a scored-suite failure (:224-226) the remaining reward.json is the gates-detailed record (gates_passed 1, reward 0.0) rather than the plain zero described in contract item 8; reward is still 0.
